map.耳鸣匹配：按频率分 低频（不超过500Hz，多梅尼埃病/中耳病变）、中频（不超过: Tinnitus matching: by frequency it is divided into low, up to 500 Hz, usually Meniere's disease or middle ear disease; mid, up to 2000 Hz; and high, above 2000 Hz, usually noise-induced or age-related hearing loss. The loudness grading guides masking therapy.

map.音调匹配：以纯音或窄带噪声由低频向高频逐一测试，患者指出最相似音调。响度匹配：在: Pitch matching presents pure tones or narrowband noise one by one from low to high frequency, and the patient indicates the pitch that sounds most similar. Loudness matching starts at a high level at the matched frequency and lowers it gradually until the patient judges it equally loud to the tinnitus, and the value is recorded in dB SL, the sensation level. The Feldmann masking curve can further characterise how the tinnitus is masked.
